ML: Yao Guan Yu 姚冠宇 
FL: Lan Lan 兰岚
Ok, watched this because of ML and FL, both excellent. The drama itself, well written & directed. But sheeez, I LOVE happy endings and this has exact opposite. 😢😢😢
这结局太悲伤了🥺😭，本人心脏不好，就不看第二次了
Yeah i kinda guessed it wouldnt be a happy ending

So male lead is a killer, female lead is a cop, her non related nephew died, and male lead, to save himself he stole her nephew identity, approached female lead, manipulated her, deceived her, 
he made her fall for him, made her fool, in the process he also fell for her, since he's a criminal, she also searching for him, being with her, he took advantage, broke her trust, got to know all the information from her, to save himself, while she has no idea who he really is 😖😖
